SELECT -- [1. 기본 정보] u.name AS studentName, a.name AS academyName, c.name AS className, (SELECT name FROM users WHERE user_id = #{teacherId}) AS teacherName,
-- [2. 성과 지표] : 해당 월의 월말평가 본인 점수 (SELECT ea.total_score FROM exam_attempts ea JOIN exams e ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.exam_type = 'MONTHLY' AND e.exam_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} LIMIT 1) AS monthlyExamScore,
-- [2. 성과 지표] : 해당 월말평가를 치른 같은 반 학생들의 평균 점수 (SELECT AVG(ea2.total_score) FROM exam_attempts ea2 WHERE ea2.exam_id = ( SELECT e.exam_id FROM exam_attempts ea JOIN exams e ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.exam_type = 'MONTHLY' AND e.exam_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} LIMIT 1 )) AS classAverageScore,
-- [3. 학습 태도 지표] : 기간 내 독서 이력 수 및 오답 극복 활동 수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reading_reports WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND created_at BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}) AS booksReadCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_logs WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND activity_type = 'OVERCOME_WRONG' AND created_at BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd}) AS overcomeWrongCount,
-- [3. 취약 유형] : 기간 내 오답이 가장 많은 문제 유형 태그 추출 (SELECT eq.question_type_tag FROM exam_answers ans JOIN exam_questions eq ON ans.question_id = eq.question_id JOIN exam_attempts ea ON ans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id JOIN exams e ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} AND ans.is_correct = false AND e.exam_date BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} GROUP BY eq.question_type_tag ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS topWeakTypeTag
FROM users u JOIN academies a ON u.academy_id = a.academy_id JOIN class_students cs ON u.user_id = cs.student_id JOIN classes c ON cs.class_id = c.class_id WHERE u.user_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1
